assumptions.choice: Used bt.ind.CrossOver(self.data.close, self.bb.lines.bot) < 0 to evaluate close crossing below the lower band
assumptions.reason: The specification states 'the close crosses below the lower band (CrossOver(bb.bot, close) < 0)'. In Backtrader, CrossOver(close, bb.bot) < 0 evaluates to True when close crosses below the lower band.

assumptions.choice: Calculated stop-loss (1.0 * ATR) and take-profit (2.0 * ATR) from the actual order execution price using ATR stored at signal time
assumptions.reason: Spec defines stops/targets relative to 'entry price'. Execution price is available upon order completion in notify_order.

assumptions.choice: Close position if 3 full bars have elapsed since entry order completion (len(self) - entry_bar >= 3)
assumptions.reason: Spec states 'close the position after 3 bars if neither the stop nor the take has triggered'.
